messages:
Jordan Mills: Postmortem follow-up: we uncovered three recurring patterns during the regional failover drill. Need owners+ETAs so we can close.
Tara Kim: OK list them and I'll take ownership of the restore runbook updates.
Jordan Mills: 1) DNS propagation delays causing sticky traffic -> owner: Network Infra -> ETA: 2024-12-05. 2) Incomplete backup manifests for incrementals -> owner: Tara Kim -> ETA: 2024-11-28. 3) No standardized rollback steps for automated failback -> owner: Jordan Mills -> ETA: 2024-12-02.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder: add playbook PR tag 'postmortem/dr-failover-2024' to runbooks repo.
Tara Kim: I'll add a manifest verification CI job that validates snapshot ids and fails the pipeline on mismatch. Will also add an alert to PDesk if >0 failures/24h.
Network Infra: We'll propose reducing DNS TTL during failover windows and add an ALB weight pre-warm script. ETA holds.
Jordan Mills: I'll draft rollback docs with explicit commands and a rapid-verification checklist to run post-failback. Will coordinate a mini-game-day to validate.
Tara Kim: PR incoming today for manifest job; will tag and request reviews.
Jordan Mills: Great. Everyone please react :white_check_mark: when PRs are open and :rocket: when merged/tests green. I'll close thread after canary verifies.
